# UPchieve Changelog, week of Oct 31 to Nov 7, 2026

*Generated by Claude from merge-request and commit activity. Details may be inaccurate; check the linked MR or ask the author.*

Last deploys: high-line Nov 6, subway Nov 6. These deploys carried the requested-coach, coach status, NTHS renewal email, Clever grade, and recap DM work that last week's digest had as merged or in review.

**Status key:** 🚀 Launched (live to everyone) | 🧪 Experimental (in production, behind a feature flag) | 🎁 Merged (ships next deploy) | ✅ Approved (reviewed, not yet merged) | 👀 In review (needs review)

---

## NTHS

The National Tutoring Honors Society, where a high school coach founds a chapter at their own school. Moving the president application out of a Google form and into the app, along with the school and chapter records behind it.

- **Renew chapters with a returning president confirming, instead of nominations:** 🚀 in May, chapter admins are asked to set next year's President on the Members tab; from Aug 1 that President confirms the chapter in Chapter HQ; if nobody has by Sept 15, every member sees a countdown and can step up. One renewal banner in Chapter HQ covers each stage, and the NTHS red dot follows it ([subway !3148](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3148), [high-line !2061](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2061)); 🚀 an hourly job sends each chapter the email for its stage (the handoff ask, the confirm reminder, the member countdown, chapter closed) and, the day after the close date, closes a chapter no president confirmed, while a chapter with no members closes regardless ([subway !3127](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3127), [subway !3134](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3134)); 🚀 a renewal candidate row counts as the president's confirmation, with its unused columns dropped, and the dates sheet rejects an `admin_reminder` row again now that both sheets dropped it ([subway !3155](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3155), [subway !3156](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3156), [subway !3157](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3157)); 🎁 Bailey's copy for the banners, with renewal dates reading "September 30th" and the red dot showing its reason on hover ([high-line !2080](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2080)). On for everyone since Nov 6 ([`nths-chapter-renewal`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/1015555)). The nomination screens built earlier in the week, where admins named a successor who then accepted or stepped down, were replaced by this before the flag came on ([subway !3129](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3129), [subway !3133](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3133); [high-line !2042](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2042), [high-line !2046](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2046)). *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Let a member step up as president when nobody can run their chapter.** When a chapter's admins have closed their accounts or aren't high school students, each cleared member sees a step-up prompt in Chapter HQ, and accepting makes them an admin and its President. From Aug 1, stepping up also confirms the chapter for renewal. ([subway !3135](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3135), [high-line !2049](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2049)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Let a chapter's only admin leave, or give up admin, while other members remain.** An admin who is the chapter's only member still gets the contact-us message. ([subway !3139](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3139), [high-line !2051](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2051)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Email members when staff close their chapter.** Closing a chapter from `/admin` sends its members the chapter closed email and updates their SendGrid contacts; deactivated and deleted accounts get no email. ([subway !3132](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3132)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Give every president applicant the long application form.** The [short-form study](https://upchieve.fibery.io/Product/Study/829) is over and Bailey kept the long form. A draft saved on the short form opens on the long form with the answers it still asks for, past short-form applications stay reviewable, and the `nths-short-application` flag is gone. ([subway !3140](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3140), [high-line !2052](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2052), [high-line !2055](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2055)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Email approved presidents by where their chapter stands, not on a fixed schedule,** toward three members by launch: a setup reminder on day 3 if they haven't created the chapter; recruiting reminders on days 3, 8, 14, and 18 while it has fewer than three members; activation emails once it has three; and launch pushed from day 21 to day 60 when it isn't there yet. One email a day at most, and the old Day 5 email is retired. ([subway !3158](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3158)) *Kasozi Wilson*

## My Coaches

Making the connections our power users make available to all users, earlier on. It runs through knowing your tutor, favorite coach presence, DMing a coach from one place instead of Session History, and in time things like asking for a specific coach.

- 🚀 **Show coaches and students the people they've worked with:** a Messages page in coaches' sidebar, listing five at a time every student they've worked with and their last session ([high-line !2028](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2028)); one card for both pages, offering a DM to coaches and a DM or a session request to students ([high-line !2027](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2027)). *Liseidy Bueno*
- **Give each coach-student pair one DM thread, apart from session recaps:** 🚀 a DM button on the cards that opens a chat panel at the side ([high-line !2043](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2043)); 🚀 the conversation created the first time either one opens it ([subway !3117](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3117)), with messages sent, stored, and loaded ([subway !3118](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3118)); 🚀 whether each student can get DMs, sent with the Messages page's list ([subway !3151](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3151)); 🚀 marking a conversation read, and listing who sent unread messages ([subway !3145](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3145)); 🎁 a red dot on My Coaches or Messages in the sidebar and an orange one on the message button for an unread DM, with opening the chat marking it read ([high-line !2060](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2060)); 🎁 the DM button only for coaches with the flag, grayed out with a tooltip for a student who can't get DMs ([high-line !2063](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2063)). Students' DM buttons are rolled out to no one yet ([`direct-messages`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/1039499)); until high-line !2063 ships, every coach has the button on the Messages page. *Liseidy Bueno*
- **Favorite a coach from My Coaches, and see more of them there:** 🚀 a star on each coach's avatar, filled yellow when favorited ([high-line !2050](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2050)); 🚀 unfavoriting no longer asks for confirmation ([high-line !2071](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2071)); ✅ the star, the coach's status, and a Request session button in the DM panel ([high-line !2070](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2070)); 👀 a hover card on the avatar with what the coach chose to share, and the coach's name opening the DM ([high-line !2068](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2068)). *Liseidy Bueno*
- **Moderate DMs the way session chat is moderated:** 🚀 every DM goes through the regex filter; a regex hit goes to AI, which blocks it unless it judges the message appropriate; a message the regex passes is checked by AI against the last 50 messages of the conversation, and blocked if no answer comes within 10 seconds ([subway !3146](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3146), [subway !3152](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3152)); 🚀 blocked attempts logged in a `censored_direct_messages` table, with `ai` added as a moderation system ([subway !3137](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3137), [subway !3144](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3144)); 🚀 a `direct_message_flags` table for conversations staff need to review, using the session flag categories ([subway !3138](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3138)); 🚀 a `direct_message_reports` table, with each flag pointing at its report ([subway !3149](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3149), [subway !3150](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3150)); 👀 students and coaches can report a DM, the way they report recap DMs ([subway !3163](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3163), [high-line !2078](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2078)); 👀 a shadow-banned student's DMs are kept from coaches, and coaches can't message them, seeing a tooltip that the student can't receive DMs ([subway !3167](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3167)). *Trey Stevens, Liseidy Bueno*
- **Show whether each coach is online, in a session, or offline, for the My Coaches redesign:** 🚀 subway tracks whether a coach is connected anywhere on UPchieve over sockets ([subway !3124](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3124)); 🚀 a `useCoachStatuses` composable the page hooks into ([high-line !2038](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2038)); 🎁 a dot and label on each coach's card ([high-line !2054](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2054)). Rolled out to no one yet ([`show-coach-status`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/1039508)). *Trey Stevens, Liseidy Bueno*
- **Measure My Coaches in PostHog:** 🚀 a `DIRECT_MESSAGE_SENT` event from subway for each DM delivered, and the recap DM event sends the message's length instead of its text ([subway !3154](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3154)); 🎁 a `DM_CONVERSATION_OPENED` event, and the coach's status on the request-coach event ([high-line !2065](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2065)). *Alex Rodriguez*
- **Let a student request a specific coach, from My Coaches too:** 🧪 subway keeps the request in Postgres instead of Redis, holds back other coaches' holds and notifications while the student waits for the coach they asked for, and texts that coach only if they haven't opted out of texts ([subway !3088](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3088)); 🧪 one request button for Session History, Session Recap, and My Coaches, where the student picks from the subjects the coach is certified in ([subway !3128](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3128), [high-line !2041](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2041)); 🎁 that button on each coach's card on My Coaches ([high-line !2064](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2064)). Requesting a coach reaches 60% of students with at least one session ([`student-request-specific-volunteer-sessions`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/713196)). *Trey Stevens, Liseidy Bueno*
- 🧪 **Decide when to ask coaches what students see about them, and what starts checked:** in the dashboard modal, undecided adult coaches start with everything shared, and high school coaches with nothing shared plus a "Turn all on" link; the modal waits until after the coach's first session, and undecided coaches get a profile callout that opens it with everything off ([high-line !2058](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2058)); closing the modal without choosing is saved on the server instead of in the browser, so the dashboard doesn't ask again on any device ([subway !3142](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3142), [subway !3143](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3143)); the session and coach ids on students' "learn more about your coach" events, so a view can be tied to a later re-request or DM, and where the coach chose on the coaches' events ([high-line !2059](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2059)). Rolled out to no one yet ([`show-volunteer-opt-in-to-share-info`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/823424)). *Alex Rodriguez*

## Coach queue

Revise the request dispatch algorithm to offer a new session to a few coaches one at a time, the way a library hold list runs down, before it goes to every coach online. Earlier digests called this Session holds.

- **Redesign the session list coaches pick requests from, which the queue will later be built into, and the dashboard banner:** 🚀 the wait time ticks up in seconds instead of reading "< 5 minutes", and reads "1hr+", "2hr+" past an hour ([high-line !2047](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2047)); 🚀 pages of 10 sessions (or 5, or 15), with arrows that scroll back to the top ([high-line !2056](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2056)); 🚀 a new design for each session row, carrying over the exclusive and locked session styles and dropping the cap of 5 locked sessions ([high-line !2067](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2067)); 👀 a gear icon for the list's settings menu in place of the caret ([high-line !2075](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2075)); 👀 a "Claimed!" badge and a slide-out when a session is picked up or cancelled, or just a fade with reduced motion ([high-line !2069](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2069)); 👀 a new dashboard banner showing the coach's stats ([high-line !2079](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2079)), from a new endpoint with the full set of coach-facing stats ([subway !3160](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3160)). *Jamie Kasulis*
- 🚀 **Dropped the `input` column from `session_offers`,** now that offers keep their scoring facts with the output. ([subway !3123](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3123)) *sammy nave*
- 🧪 **Offer sessions to coaches one at a time, in place of session holds:** half the sessions students request are hidden from the session list and offered to the top-ranked eligible coach, who has 10 seconds to accept or decline before it goes to the next; when no coach takes it within 2 minutes, or nobody is left to offer it to, it's listed for everyone with the usual notifications ([subway !3141](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3141), [subway !3147](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3147), [subway !3159](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3159), [subway !3162](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3162)); the session hold alert becomes a session offer alert, with the student's name, the subject, and a countdown ([high-line !2062](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2062)). Students without a school partner are in it, and offers go to the half of coaches without a school partner in its test group ([`session-offers`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/1031506), [`session-offers-coach`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/1036651)). Session holds were switched off the same day, and so was the shadow ranking that recorded offers without making them. *sammy nave*
- 👀 **Score coaches with version 4 of the scorecard:** points come faster for time spent waiting for a session and slower for days since the last session, and new tiers give one award by group instead of a rate: a bonus for 2 to 6 sessions, a smaller one for 7 to 13, and a boost for power tutors with 50 or more. ([subway !3165](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3165)) *sammy nave*

## End-to-end test suite

A browser test suite that drives high-line against a real subway, plus the work to make it run in CI.

- 👀 **End each e2e student's sessions after every test, pass or fail.** A failed chat test left its student's request open, so every coach who signed in later got a "needs help" toast; on Mobile Chrome it covered the member menu and failed another MR's e2e job. ([high-line !2081](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2081)) *Ben Wheeler*

## Pinia migration

Moving high-line's state management from Vuex to Pinia.

- 🚀 **Moved the NTHS store to a Pinia setup store,** `src/stores/nths.ts`, with no change in behavior. It reads the user and feature flags from Vuex until those move too. ([high-line !2066](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2066)) *Ben Wheeler*

## Component library

Pulling high-line's presentation components out of the components that handle data, so non-engineers can change how the app looks without affecting how it works.

- 👀 **Lint the presentation components for hand-written design values.** stylelint on `src/components/PresentationComponents/` only: colors, spacing, radius, fonts, and transitions there must use a variable or mixin from `src/scss/setup`. ([high-line !1998](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1998)) *Chris*

## Quick wins, fixes, chores, and other small things

- 🚀 **Remind people under the chat box that sessions are monitored:** "We review every session. Please be respectful." The partnerships team asked for it because high school coaches share personal information more often. The composer was restyled to the approved design, and the whiteboard toggle no longer covers its toolbar. ([high-line !2053](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2053)) *Kasozi Wilson*
- 🚀 **Count `.org` addresses as school emails for the secondary email prompt.** Most students use `.org` addresses, which kept them from seeing it. ([high-line !2073](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2073)) *Kasozi Wilson*
- 🚀 **Shorten the reCAPTCHA notice to "This site is protected by reCAPTCHA."** ([high-line !2039](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2039)) *Alex Lindsay*
- **Build high-line as an Android app in CI:** 🚀 a Docker image with the Android build setup baked in, so the Capacitor build doesn't redo it on every pipeline ([high-line !2074](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2074)); 👀 a pipeline that builds the staging app, which talks to the staging backend, and uploads it to Google Play's internal testing track ([high-line !2076](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2076)). *Alex Lindsay*
- 🧪 **Offer new BigFuture students a college counseling session right after onboarding.** Taking this prompt away had cut new-student activation significantly. A modal asks "Want help getting into college?", and its button takes the student straight into a session, skipping subject selection and the presession questions. The session's topic is split between college list (50%), college prep (25%), and planning (25%). Reaches BigFuture students ([`auto-start-college-session`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/1027334)). ([high-line !2057](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2057)) *Kasozi Wilson*
- 🚀 **Skip the Redis read when refreshing a single-role user's roles.** A forced refresh goes to Postgres first and reads Redis only for users with more than one role, to keep their active role. ([subway !3126](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3126)) *Kasozi Wilson*
- 🎁 **Add ESLint to subway** with one rule on, `use-unknown-in-catch-callback-variable`, so `.catch()` callbacks still logging in the old argument order get caught. ([subway !3046](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3046)) *Alex Lindsay*
- ✅ **Backfill `users_schools` with students' and teachers' schools,** with a one-off script, and write teachers' schools there too, as part of moving school records to `users_schools`. ([subway !2581](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2581)) *Jamie Kasulis*
- 👀 **Time out Redis commands after 2 seconds,** except on subscriber clients, with every Redis client built from one factory and command errors logged. ([subway !3136](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3136)) *Jamie Kasulis*

### Fixes

- 🚀 **Keep a coach from joining a second session.** Coaches could join one while another was still open, and then couldn't communicate. A coach with a session open gets a modal pointing them to its banner instead, and leftover session notifications clear in every tab once they're in a session. 🐛 [#751](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/751) ([subway !3131](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3131), [high-line !2045](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2045)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Let people select and copy text in the session chat on touch screens.** Ionic's mobile styles had the same specificity as ours, so depending on load order they won. Our selector goes through `#app` now. 🐛 [#745](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/745) ([high-line !2048](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2048)) *Trey Stevens*
- 🚀 **Switch back to the desktop layout when an iPad's Safari sidebar closes.** Closing it could leave the app in its phone layout while the CSS went back to desktop, a broken mix until reload. The app reads the breakpoint through `matchMedia` now. 🐛 [#749](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/749) ([high-line !2044](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2044)) *Kasozi Wilson*
- 🚀 **Take a new Clever student's grade from Clever.** New Clever students were asked to confirm their grade on the dashboard. Signing up or linking through Clever takes Clever's grade now, over the sign-up form's. 🐛 [#736](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/736) ([subway !3119](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3119)) *Jamie Kasulis*
- 🚀 **Mark the right recap DMs as read.** Session Recap showed its chat before the recap session loaded, so it sent `undefined` as the session id, or marked an earlier recap's messages read. ([high-line !2040](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2040)) *Alex Lindsay*
- 🚀 **Send volunteers back to the first sign-up step after a reload.** Reloading the "about" step failed with "email: undefined is not a string" and created no account, for about 118 visitors in the last 30 days. The partner key and team invite code stay in the URL; a partner link no longer carries into a later open sign-up in the same tab; and partner links land on `?partnerKey=`, with old `?partnerId=` links still working. ([high-line !1971](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1971)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 👀 **Make error messages stand out again with alert styles.** Bootstrap went a long time ago and nothing replaced its alert styles, so many error messages look like any other text on the page. ([high-line !2082](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2082)) *Alex Lindsay*
- 👀 **Seed `report_reasons` once, so a fresh local database starts.** Since subway !3150 the test seeds loaded it and `direct_message_reports` twice. The CI seed load now stops on psql errors, so the `test_database` job catches the next one. ([subway !3168](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3168)) *Ben Wheeler*
